title: RDK-B Core Broadband Memory Footprint by Process
description: Per-profile measured (or pending) memory footprint by process (RSS). Kept as a separate file from hw-compat.schema.json so footprint data can be updated as components are profiled without touching the CPU/RAM/flash/peripheral spec file.

specVersion.description: Version of this JSON schema (semantic version), e.g. "1.0".

profileId.description: Matches the profileId in the corresponding hw-compat.schema.json file for this profile.

measured.description: True if RSS has been measured on a reference device for at least one process; false if this profile is pending profiling.

referenceDevice.description: Optional. Device the measurement was taken on, e.g. "BPI-R4 (MediaTek MT7988, Filogic)".

lastMeasured.description: Optional. ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent measurement pass.

totalRssMB.description: Optional. Total measured RSS in MB across all processes, including any not individually listed.

usedMemoryMB.description: Optional. System-level used RAM in MB (MemTotal - MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo at capture time), per Section 3.5 MEM-006 guidance. This is the correct figure to compare against a profile's minRamMB floor -- unlike totalRssMB, it does not double-count shared pages across processes and will always be lower than the sum of individual process RSS values.

processes.description: Per-process RSS entries, typically sorted descending by rssMB. Empty when measured is false.

rssMB.description: Resident set size in MB, or "TBD" if this specific process has not yet been measured.

componentRepo.description: Optional. RDK-B Component List repo name for cross-reference.

othersRssMB.description: Optional. Aggregate RSS in MB for remaining processes not individually broken out.

notes.description: Optional. Free-text notes, e.g. explaining what 'Others' covers or why a profile is unmeasured.
